companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Pass the company or account name for B2B. Leave blank for a consumer; Apex will create a household-style account.

email.title: Email
email.description: Customer email. Required. Use the address they provided.

firstName.title: First Name
firstName.description: Pass the first name the customer stated. Do not invent or split a full name incorrectly; ask if unclear.

lastName.title: Last Name
lastName.description: Pass the last name the customer stated. Required even if they only gave one name; ask for last name first.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Pass the phone they provided. Leave blank if they declined. Do not generate a number.
